caption: Palazzo Ducale, Mantua
composition: Ducal Palace façades on Piazza Sordello · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: Across the vast empty Piazza Sordello, the tourist faces the long brick mass of the Palazzo Ducale, its crenellated medieval towers punctuating the skyline left of center. Rows of tall windows march along the facade above a ground-floor arcade, with a paler stone wing and arched portal at the right edge. Soft 07:32 morning light filters through broken cloud, and the piazza's paving stretches quiet in the foreground.
